name: Oonishi Konatsu
source:
A girl who loves standing out and is crazy about events.

She tends to charge straight down her own path, but often acts without paying much attention to what’s going on around her.
Because of that, if the people around her don’t properly watch over her, there’s no telling what she might end up doing.
She clearly states what she likes and what she hates—no half measures.
She’s especially weak when it comes to her twin older sister, Koharu.
And for some reason, even though she’s not from Kansai, she speaks in Kansai dialect…?

[b]Occupation:[/b] Student + part-time flower shop worker
[b]Likes:[/b] Chocolate, reptiles
[b]Dislikes:[/b] Carrots, celery, parsley, butterflies
[b]Hobby:[/b] Solo comedy routines (studying jokes and punchlines)

[b]"Aniki!"[/b]
